title.en: 450 kg is mass is the Electric 15 Concrete Pump cell under “Pressure Drop - SI units”
title.zh: 「两者都印 15 kW。」是「压降 - 国际单位制」下面的电动15的订单没有压力格可填格子

description.en: Electric 15 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-15-concrete-pump. 450 kg is mass Both print 15 kW
description.zh: 电动15的订单没有压力格可填见 /products/electric-15-concrete-pump。两者都印 15 kW。450 kg 是质量。

h1.en: Keep Electric 15 Concrete Pump under “Pressure Drop - Imperial Units” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「压降 - 英制单位」下保留电动15的订单没有压力格可填，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 15 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-15-concrete-pump. 450 kg is mass. Both print 15 kW. 80 mm is Electric 20. The frame is 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. Vertical is 15–20 m and horizontal is 60–80 m. B500S-83D is lighter, at 280 kg, and only 5 m / 5 m. Do not substitute it when you need the Electric 15 ranges. They are not single guarantees and not Electric 20’s 120 m / 40 m. Electric 10 Series, also 15 kW, is a different order at 21 m³/h and 25 m horizontal. Send the Electric 15 path to /en/contact/ with your stone and your supply voltage as site facts. An Electric 15 purchase from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai copies nine facts: 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m, horizontal 60–80 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, pipe 100–125 mm, 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm and 450 kg, plus the path. The section title “Pressure Drop - SI units” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是电动15的订单没有压力格可填的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-15-concrete-pump。两者都印 15 kW。450 kg 是质量。80 mm 是电动20。是 100–125 mm。当你需要电动15的范围时，不要用它替换。垂直是 15–20 m，水平是 60–80 m。外形是 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。它们不是单项保证，也不是电动20的 120 m / 40 m。B500S-83D 更轻，280 kg，而且只有 5 m / 5 m。同样是 15 kW 的电动10系列是另一张订单：21 m³/h、水平 25 m。把电动15的路径连同你的石子和供电电压作为现场事实，发到 /zh/contact/。向河北品锦机械（邢台）采购电动15，抄这些事实：15 kW、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、骨料 1–3 cm、管径 100–125 mm、1900 × 900 × 1200 mm、450 kg，以及路径。节标题「压降 - 国际单位制」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: Electric 15 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Pressure Drop - SI units”. 450 kg is mass. The frame is 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. Do not substitute it when you need the Electric 15 ranges. Send the Electric 15 path to /en/contact/ with your stone and your supply voltage as site facts.
body.zh: 电动15的订单没有压力格可填不因标题「压降 - 国际单位制」而改动。450 kg 是质量。外形是 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。两者都印 15 kW。当你需要电动15的范围时，不要用它替换。

body.en: This section is titled “Pressure Drop - Imperial Units”. Electric 15 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. Both print 15 kW. Vertical is 15–20 m and horizontal is 60–80 m. They are not single guarantees and not Electric 20’s 120 m / 40 m. An Electric 15 purchase from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai copies nine facts: 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m, horizontal 60–80 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, pipe 100–125 mm, 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm and 450 kg, plus the path.
body.zh: 本节标题是「压降 - 英制单位」。电动15的订单没有压力格可填下面这些格子仍是印出来的。向河北品锦机械（邢台）采购电动15，抄这些事实：15 kW、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、骨料 1–3 cm、管径 100–125 mm、1900 × 900 × 1200 mm、450 kg，以及路径。垂直是 15–20 m，水平是 60–80 m。它们不是单项保证，也不是电动20的 120 m / 40 m。是 100–125 mm。

body.en: Under “Friction Loss Table”, Electric 15 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. 80 mm is Electric 20. B500S-83D is lighter, at 280 kg, and only 5 m / 5 m. Electric 10 Series, also 15 kW, is a different order at 21 m³/h and 25 m horizontal. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-pipe-schedule-80-friction-loss-diagram-d_1146.html.
body.zh: 在「摩擦损失 表」下，电动15的订单没有压力格可填这一节只放已印出的格子。80 mm 是电动20。B500S-83D 更轻，280 kg，而且只有 5 m / 5 m。同样是 15 kW 的电动10系列是另一张订单：21 m³/h、水平 25 m。把电动15的路径连同你的石子和供电电压作为现场事实，发到 /zh/contact/。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-pipe-schedule-80-friction-loss-diagram-d_1146.html。

question.en: Does “Pressure Drop - SI units” replace 450 kg is mass?
question.zh: 「压降 - 国际单位制」会替换「两者都印 15 kW。」吗？

answer.en: No. 450 kg is mass remains the printed wording for Electric 15 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。两者都印 15 kW。仍是电动15的订单没有压力格可填已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Both print 15 kW belong on the Electric 15 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 电动15的订单没有压力格可填这一行里，「450 kg 是质量。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-15-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-15-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Pressure Drop - Imperial Units” add to Electric 15 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「压降 - 英制单位」给电动15的订单没有压力格可填增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-pipe-schedule-80-friction-loss-diagram-d_1146.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-pipe-schedule-80-friction-loss-diagram-d_1146.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside 450 kg is mass?
question.zh: 「两者都印 15 kW。」旁边印了标价吗？
